AmbDescription:
Hey Indiana friends! Ready to get a jump start on the Dungeon Canicross Crawl, or simply ready to dust off the summer cobwebs and get running again? 

The weather is looking gorgeous for Sunday and I hope to see you there. There's multiple trails in various lengths, so you can choose your own adventure whether you're a long distance runner or just getting started.

WHERE:
We will plan on meeting at the Briar Patch Shelter at Bonneyville Mill County Park in Bristol, Indiana

53373 Co Rd 131, Bristol, IN 46507
41°42'57.1"N 85°45'53.4"W

RUN:
From the Briar Patch Shelter, you have 2 nearby trails to hop onto: 
   (1) South Loop = 1.15mi. It's a nice trail with a mixture of scenery, restrooms along the route, and an overlook area sort of around the halfway mark. There are additional trail segments (mileage not included) so if you wanted to do more than one lap, you'd have different scenery each time!
   (2) Valley Line Loop = 0.6mi. Across the street from South Loop. More grassy and narrower trail running alongside a small pond, restrooms and shelter also along this trail. 

RSVP:
Please mark "Interested" or "Going" if you plan on joining me! I don't want any chance of canceling an event and you showing up without me. 
I'll include a map of the trails on the Facebook event page. Please don't hesitate to message me if you have any questions or hesitations beforehand!

AmbDescription:
Are you ready for a fun social run at a great place with fabulous people!  Fort Custer recreation is a perfect location with numerous trails to choose from.  Saturday, 11/7, the Mid Union Sled Haulers (MUSH) are holding their annual fall race there.  Sunday, 11/8 we are going to do a social training run.  Distance is yet to be determined.  I’ll be relying on fellow MUSH club members to pick the route so we don’t get lost as they know the trails better than I do.  All running abilities are highly encouraged to join!  Stay around after the run and visit with some of the other MUSH members who also participate in other aspects of dryland racing.  

MUSH membership is not required for the social run on 11/8, however it is required if you’d like to race on 11/7.  State park pass is required for entry in the park.  Parking will be designated to a particular area of the campground (campsites #111 through #219).  Water sources are available on site along with bathroom facilities.  

If you are NOT a titling member of North American Canicross, first, why not?  Second, there is a waiver to sign for NACC.  There is not a digital link but I can forward it over to you.  Also check out NACC at https://nacanicross.com/
